ingest.note: input.csv was read with pandas.read_csv defaults; the Rust reader must treat these tokens as null

edge_layout: [i, j, weight] with i < j, sorted

pca_embeddings.note: randomized SVD (Halko); a re-implementation may need per-column sign alignment

resolve_clusters_spectral.note: Rust labels the spectral embedding with k-means++, Python with sklearn discretize; the fixture graphs are well separated, so the partitions must agree

temporal.note: numpy reduces time lanes pairwise; Rust sums sequentially

trajectory.note: CO_SIMILAR weights; observations, balls, members, edge endpoints and component labels are exact

panel.note: imputed snapshot values; ids, times, reports, notes and error envelopes are exact

longitudinal_payloads.note: payload values are rounded as in Python; ranked lists break ties by first appearance (numpy's order inside a tie was unspecified)

bundle.note: float32 columns; integer, string, bool columns, schemas and manifests exact except config_hash; spectral layout checked as Laplacian eigenvectors (unique only up to sign and eigenspace basis)

graph_artifact.note: sparsifier edges and metrics; endpoints, counts and labels exact

html_report.note: byte-identical HTML for graphs under 500 nodes (networkx force layout)
